meta.title: SPACTs | Take 3 Agency
meta.description: A SPACT (Special Action Extra) is a background artist with a real, proven skill: a fighter, driver, dancer, gymnast or rider who can perform it safely, repeatably, on camera. Take 3 Agency supplies SPACTs across nine core disciplines to film, television and commercial productions.
meta.ogDescription: Real skills, delivered safely on camera. Take 3 Agency supplies Special Action Performers across nine core disciplines.

hero.title: SPACTs
hero.strapline: Real skills, delivered safely on camera.

what.heading: A performer, not just a face in the crowd.
what.paragraph: A SPACT (Special Action Extra) is a background artist with a real, proven skill: a fighter, driver, dancer, gymnast or rider who can perform that skill safely, repeatably, on camera. Productions book them where a scene needs genuine ability in the background, not a mime of it.

disciplines.heading: Disciplines
disciplines.note: There's a fine line between SPACT and stunt work. Our team will advise on the right booking for the action you need.

distinctions.heading: SPACT, Stunt Performer, Supporting Artist
distinctions.intro: The three roles sit on one spectrum of screen action, and the honest answer is that the lines are drawn by risk, pay and responsibility, not by talent.
distinctions.selectPrompt: SELECT A ROLE, OR CLICK A PERFORMER IN THE FRAME, TO ISOLATE THEM

roles.title: SUPPORTING ARTIST
roles.body: Populates the world of the scene, with no special skill required or asked for on camera.

roles.title: SPACT
roles.body: A supporting artist booked for a verified special skill, performing real action within limits agreed with the AD and stunt departments.

roles.title: STUNT PERFORMER
roles.body: A registered professional engaged for hazardous action under a stunt coordinator's supervision, never a SPACT booking.

distinctions.frameAlt: Production frame: stunt performer, SPACT and supporting artists

distinctions.note: The line between SPACT and stunt work is a judgement call on risk, and it belongs to the stunt coordinator. A good agency flags the borderline cases before they reach set; it's a conversation we have with productions weekly.

film.heading: Booked under crowd. Delivering more.
film.paragraph: SPACTs come through the crowd budget but bring featured-level action: fights that land, riders who ride, soldiers who move like soldiers. Recent productions we've supplied:

commercial.heading: When the campaign needs it done for real.
items: Car campaigns that need a driver who can perform, not just pose.
Sportswear films that want genuine free-runners and gymnasts.
Cinematic spots calling for fight or aerial work.
Live events that need circus and movement artists.

cards.title: A vetted roster
cards.body: Every artist assessed and interviewed by our team before they join. They are exactly who we say they are.

cards.title: We handle the paperwork
cards.body: Contracts, fees, overtime, buyouts and on-the-day coordination, dealt with by us, not your team.

cards.title: One relationship
cards.body: Every discipline through a single point of contact, from a lone precision driver to a full crowd of fighters.
